verifiedInterpretation: Each caption has primary and repeat still images plus per-line masks and alpha/bounds inspection. Existing completed-child logs show serial rather than concurrent native children in sampled windows.
Recent per-cue walltime is near 14 seconds. Actual observed child render/inspection sum is near 4.6 seconds per cue; the other approximately 9.2 seconds lie outside those child timings.
Previous still and line-mask child averages are close to current averages; the walltime increase is mainly outside child timings, not evidence that the still renderer itself became twice as slow.

parentSourceReadObservation.source: Parent /root message during this task, following its direct code read; not an independently timed control substage.
parentSourceReadObservation.observation: Normal approved-job current() lacks old fixed-context 900ms throttle and checks implementation/input hashes, git status, diskutil/hdiutil before/after repeated Remotion/ImageMagick children. Child timing excludes these wrapper checks.
parentSourceReadObservation.inference: This control-path difference is consistent with measured extra inter-child gaps. No individual wrapper check duration was measured here.

limits: Rates from primary PNG file mtimes include inter-cue rendering and inspections, but latest PNG existence is not proof its final image QC has finished.
Outside-child gap includes qualifications, parent work, file saves/readback, launches, and other uninstrumented work. It cannot all be assigned to one check, SSD, or CPU.
Total caption count differs: 651 now versus 372 before. Content/line counts and control versions differ; this is not a controlled benchmark.
No actual CPU utilization, disk latency, persistent SSD transfer throughput, or storage-throttling measurement exists in this evidence.
Composite is still future at this checkpoint. Linear estimate is not a guarantee or full completion/delivery ETA.
